ev.q: Percentage of Adults Aged ≥45 Years Who Need Help with Routine Activities by Age Group and Selected Race/Ethnicity

The figure above shows the percentage of adults aged ≥45 years who need help with routine activities
Needing help with routine activities increased steadily with age for all racial/ethnic groups.
Non-Hispanic blacks were more likely to need help with routine activities compared with Hispanics and non-Hispanic whites among those aged 45-74 years.
Among adults aged 45-54 years, Hispanics were least likely to need help with routine activities.
National Health Interview Survey, United States, 2011
